outcome: Gene expression of smooth muscle (SM) alpha-actin
Gene expression of smooth muscle (SM) gamma-actin
Gene expression of smooth muscle (SM) myosin
Protein localization of SM-actin isoforms and SM-myosin
cohort: The study participants were bitches diagnosed with primary uterine inertia (n=11) or obstructive dystocia (n=7) undergoing Cesarean sections.
finding: Bitches with primary uterine inertia exhibited significantly higher uterine SM-gamma-actin and SM-myosin mRNA levels compared to those with obstructive dystocia, and PUI bitches carrying large litters had lower uterine SM-gamma-actin gene expression than those with small litters.
